hero.subtitle: At GYDI, your privacy is our priority. This policy describes how we collect, use and protect your personal information.

intro.title: Commitment to Your Privacy
intro.text: GYDI ("we", "our") is committed to protecting the privacy of all users ("you", "your") of our referral platform for rental properties. This policy complies with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) and other applicable data protection laws.

s1.title: 1. Information We Collect
s1.paymentText: Banking information for commission processing (processed by PCI-DSS certified providers)
s1.usageText: Pages visited, clicks, time on site
s1.deviceText: IP address, browser type, operating system
s1.social: Social media data (if you connect your account)

s2.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
s2.servicesText: Manage your account, process transactions, calculate and pay commissions
s2.communicationText: Send you confirmations, updates, security notifications
s2.marketingText: Send offers and promotions (only with your consent, you can unsubscribe at any time)
s2.securityText: Detect fraud, protect against malicious activities
s2.legalText: Comply with regulatory obligations, resolve disputes
s2.gdpr: Legal basis (GDPR): We process data based on consent, contract execution, legitimate interest and legal obligations.

s3.title: 3. Sharing Your Information
s3.intro: We do not sell your personal data.
s3.providersText: Payment processors (Stripe, PayPal), hosting (AWS, Vercel), email (SendGrid), analytics (Google Analytics)
s3.ownersText: If you book a property, we share necessary contact information
s3.affiliatesText: If you registered through a referral, we share aggregated statistics (not personal data)
s3.authoritiesText: When required by law or to protect legal rights
s3.mergersText: In case of business sale or transfer (with prior notice)

s4.title: 4. Security of Your Data
s4.encryptionText: SSL/TLS for data in transit, AES-256 for data at rest
s4.authText: Passwords hashed with bcrypt, two-factor authentication (2FA) available
s4.accessText: Principle of least privilege, quarterly access reviews
s4.warning: Important: No system is 100% secure. If you suspect unauthorized activity on your account, contact us immediately at

s5.title: 5. Your Privacy Rights
s5.intro: You have the following rights over your personal data:
s5.accessText: Request a copy of all the data we hold about you
s5.deletionText: Request deletion of your data ("right to be forgotten")
s5.portabilityText: Get your data in structured and portable format
s5.restrictionText: Limit how we process your data
s5.objectionText: Object to processing based on legitimate interest
s5.complaintText: File a complaint with a data protection authority
s5.exerciseIntro: To exercise any of these rights:
s5.exerciseSettings: Go to Settings → Privacy in your account

s6.title: 6. Data Retention
s6.intro: We retain your personal data for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes described in this policy:
s6.accountText: While your account is active + 2 years after closure

s7.title: 7. Children's Privacy
s7.text: GYDI is not directed at individuals under 18 years of age. We do not intentionally collect information from minors. If you are a parent/guardian and believe your child has provided us with data, contact us to delete it immediately.

s8.title: 8. International Transfers
s8.intro: Your data may be transferred and processed in countries outside your jurisdiction, including the United States. We implement appropriate safeguards:
s8.scc: Standard Contractual Clauses (SCC) approved by the EU

s9.title: 9. Cookies and Tracking Technologies
s9.text: We use cookies and similar technologies. For detailed information, see our

s10.intro: We may update this policy occasionally. Significant changes will be notified by:
s10.continued: Continued use of GYDI after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.
